title: Backtracking
definition: Backtracking systematically searches all configurations to find valid solutions, abandoning partial paths immediately when invalid.
intuition: Trial-and-error path construction: make a choice, explore, undo if it doesn't work out.
how_it_works: Recursively builds solutions step-by-step. If a step leads to violation, it returns (backtracks) to previous state.
when_to_use: For permutations, combinations, subsets, constraint satisfaction problems.
when_not_to_use: When direct polynomial-time options are available.
common_mistakes: Not reverting states properly after backtracking
content: Backtracking systematically searches all configurations to find valid solutions, abandoning partial paths immediately when invalid.
